environment: The X post details Sakana AI's ICLR 2026 paper titled 'DiffusionBlocks: 通过扩散解释进行块级神经网络训练', explaining how treating forward propagation as diffusion denoising allows training neural networks block by block to reduce linear memory growth, accompanied by a diagram comparing 'Standard Training' and 'Block-wise Training'.
text_visible: 十多年来，我们一直认为端到端反向传播是训练深度网络的唯一方法，但将整个网络同时加载到内存中，正是人工智能训练面临资源瓶颈的原因。

text_visible: 介绍 DiffusionBlocks：通过扩散解释进行块级神经网络训练
如果我们不需要在内存中保存整个神经网络来训练它会怎样？
标准的神经网络训练会联合优化所有参数。因此，训练期间所需的内存会随着网络深度的增加而线性增长。
在我们的#ICLR2026论文中，我们提出了DiffusionBlocks，这是一个有原则的框架，用于一次训练一个网络块，大幅减少内存需求，同时匹配端到端的性能。
使用DiffusionBlocks，我们将网络分割成块并一次训练一个块，因此你只需要为单个块分配内存。
怎么做？我们明确为每个块分配一个角色：将表示移动得比前一个块更接近目标。这个角色恰好就是扩散模型逐步执行的精确操作。每个块只需要优化自己的目标，并且可以独立训练。

text_visible: 十多年来，我们一直认为端到端反向传播是训练深度网络的唯一方法，但将整个网络同时加载到内存中，正是人工智能训练面临资源瓶颈的原因。
我们找到了一种新方法，将网络分解成块并独立训练它们。诀窍是什么？将网络的前向传播视为扩散模型对信号的去噪过程。
这种重新诠释大幅减少了训练深度模型所需的内存。在我们的ICLR2026论文中，我们在 ViTs、DiTs 和 LLMs 上达到了端到端性能

text_visible: 本文通过使用向量奖励来训练模型生成多样化的答案集，然后随机加权奖励维度，从而使每个答案都能够在不同的权重组合中专精。

在推理、工具使用、导航和编码方面，随着搜索预算的增加，VPO 提升了 best@k 和 pass@k 指标，甚至解决了 GRPO 无法触及的困难 OpenEvolve 问题。

To the right stands a bright yellow perimeter fence; to the left is a white multi-story building. A large concrete support column decorated with a colorful painted mural stands near the bottom of the stairs. Residential high-rises and green trees are visible in the background.
details: My gaze focuses on the steps directly ahead as my feet step down.

action: I say '大家好。' while descending the stairs.
action_brief: I say '大家好。'
environment: No change.
details: I utter a brief greeting while maintaining my downward walking pace.

action: I continue walking down the flight of stairs toward the ground landing.
action_brief: I walk down stairs.
environment: Approaching the base of the stairs; a red ground pipe, an orange public litter bin, and a yellow fire hydrant become clearly visible on the paved sidewalk below.
details: My gaze tracks the step edges and tactile yellow warning pavers near the bottom landing.

action: I step off the staircase onto the paved concrete sidewalk and walk past the mural-painted pillar.
action_brief: I walk past a mural pillar.
environment: Bright sunlight hits the paved concrete ground. The large column features cartoon figures dining and playing table tennis. A street and apartment buildings sit ahead across metal roadside guardrails.
details: I pass between the column and the metal guardrail toward the roadside opening.

action: I walk past the pedestrian guardrail onto the roadway pedestrian crossing marked 'LOOK RIGHT 望右'.
action_brief: I approach a pedestrian crossing.
environment: Roadway asphalt surface with painted white road markings: 'LOOK RIGHT 望右' with a right arrow and 'LOOK LEFT 望左' with a left arrow.
details: My gaze scans the road markings and the yellow tactile pavement at the curb edge.

action: I cross the roadway toward the opposite sidewalk adjacent to the 'Books & Chill' storefront.
action_brief: I cross the roadway.
environment: Opposite side shows a white building with sign '富山閣' and an elevated balcony shop with a green sign reading 'Books & Chill'. A red and white striped cone sits near the sidewalk railing.
details: I step across the asphalt toward the curb and pedestrian railing near the shop.

action: I walk along the concrete sidewalk next to a building and metal roadside railing.
action_brief: I walk along the sidewalk.
environment: Outdoor street sidewalk in daylight. A storefront building is on the left with a 'Books & Chill' sign above. Metal railings separate the walkway from the roadway on the right, where parked cars are visible ahead under tree shade. Ambient urban outdoor sounds.
details: Moving forward while looking down at the pavement surface.

action: I continue walking along the narrow pathway between parked vehicles and a wall as a pedestrian approaches from ahead.
action_brief: I walk past parked vehicles.
environment: Narrowing street path bordered by a silver SUV and wall on the left, a grey Mercedes-Benz (KS 699) on the right, and a pedestrian in blue walking toward me.
details: Passing the silver SUV on the left and grey sedan on the right.

action: I walk past a red Mercedes parked beside a driveway entrance toward outdoor concrete steps.
action_brief: I walk toward concrete steps.
environment: The path opens slightly on the left showing an underground garage entrance with a red Mercedes hatchback (PT 2368). Ahead is a short set of outdoor stairs along a white wall.
details: Advancing toward the base of the outdoor steps.

action: I walk up the concrete steps next to a green hedge wall.
action_brief: I walk up the steps.
environment: Outdoor concrete steps bordered on the left by a wall covered in green hedge top and on the right by a grey lamppost and street roadway.
details: Stepping up several yellow-edged concrete stairs.

action: I step onto the tiled entrance landing and stop before a grey slatted metal gate.
action_brief: I approach a metal gate.
environment: Light tiled front landing outside a large dark grey horizontal-slatted security gate with a wooden handle plaque marked '拉 PULL'.
details: Facing the gate handle directly.

action: I push open the grey metal security gate at the entrance to the residential courtyard.
action_brief: I open the security gate.
environment: PHYSICAL SPACE: Outdoor residential courtyard entrance leading to a multi-story white residential apartment building during bright daylight. The ground is paved with light grey stone tiles. OBJECTS: A tall horizontal-slat grey metal security gate with a vertical wooden push handle and intercom keycard reader on the right; a raised white-walled planter with green bushes on the left foreground; a yellow cone marker in the courtyard background; decorative geometric wooden slat panels on the building exterior. TEXT IN THE WORLD: A metal plate on the gate reading '如需要任何協助, 請聯絡管理處 / If you need any assistance, please contact Management Office at / XXX-XXXX-XXXX'; building logo signage reading 'Hill' above the lobby entrance. MEDIA / AUDIO: Ambient outdoor city sounds.
text_visible: 如需要任何協助, 請聯絡管理處
If you need any assistance, please contact Management Office at
details: My left hand pushes forward against the vertical wood handle panel of the gate to swing it open.

action: I walk along the tiled outdoor courtyard pathway past the planter box toward the building lobby entrance.
action_brief: I walk across the courtyard.
environment: Moving along the open courtyard under an overhang. On the left sits a multi-tier metal shelf unit holding miscellaneous maintenance supplies and a white plastic bin. A yellow 'Caution Wet Floor' cone stands on the tile floor.
details: Walking forward steadily while looking straight ahead toward the lobby doors and the planter along the left.

action: I approach the glass lobby entrance door, reach out with my right hand, and pull the door open.
action_brief: I pull open the lobby door.
environment: Building lobby entryway featuring dark grey textured stone wall tiles, slatted wooden ceiling with linear LED lights, and a black bench along the left wall. Through the glass door, a small round table with a blue-and-white checkered tablecloth is visible inside.
details: I grip the vertical handle of the right glass door with my right hand and pull it outward to open.

action: I enter the residential lobby, walk past the reception counter toward the elevator bank, and reach to press the elevator call button.
action_brief: I approach the elevator call button.
environment: Interior building lobby with grey marble-style tiled flooring and walls, wooden beam ceiling. A white-fronted reception counter desk with a wooden countertop stands on the right, accompanied by an office chair. A wall-mounted commercial display shows a DBS credit card promotion ('DBS Live Fresh 信用卡 / 網上消費5%自主現金回贈...'). On the left wall is a wooden framed cork notice board titled '通告 Notice'. Two silver brushed-metal elevator doors (labeled 2 and 1) face forward.
details: I walk directly toward the center wall between elevator 1 and elevator 2, raising my right hand toward the up call button.

action: I watch elevator 1 arrive at the ground floor with the door sliding open, and step inside the cabin.
action_brief: I enter the elevator.
environment: Elevator 1 digital display lights up indicating '^ G'. The brushed stainless steel sliding doors open to reveal an empty elevator cabin with polished stainless steel walls and a grey-and-white veined marble tile floor.
details: I step across the threshold into the interior of elevator car 1.

action: I look at the elevator operation panel and press the circular button for floor 15 with my right index finger.
action_brief: I press the 15th floor button.
environment: Inside the elevator cabin facing the right-side control column. The control panel contains rows of square metallic buttons for floors G, 1 through 23, and door control buttons. Above it, the digital matrix display shows '^ G'. A small framed certificate hangs to the left of the button panel.
details: I reach up with my right hand and press the '15' button, causing its square background border to illuminate in blue.

action: I stand inside the elevator cabin holding my phone in my hands as the sliding doors close.
action_brief: I wait as elevator doors close.
environment: The stainless steel double sliding elevator doors close fully, sealing the cabin.
details: I look down at the floor near the doorway as the doors shut completely, holding my smartphone in my hands.

action: I look down and check the lock screen on my smartphone while the elevator begins ascending.
action_brief: I check my smartphone lock screen.
environment: The elevator floor indicator advances from '^ G' to '^ 1'. The smartphone in my hands illuminates its lock screen displaying the digital clock '10:54' along with the date.
details: I hold the smartphone with both hands, viewing the clock on the OLED lock screen display.

action: I hold my iPhone in both hands and glance at the lock screen notification summary before swiping up to unlock.
action_brief: I swipe to unlock my iPhone.
environment: Elevator interior with brushed stainless steel walls, marble flooring, and an illuminated floor button panel (15 lit up, passing lower floors). I hold an iPhone in a yellow case. Ambient elevator motor hum.
details: I look at the order notification summary modal on the lock screen and use my right thumb to swipe up from the bottom home indicator.

action: I say '办公楼，fifteen floor，十五楼。'
action_brief: I say '办公楼，fifteen floor，十五楼。'
environment: Elevator floor indicator passes floors 5 to 7.
details: I speak while holding the phone at the iOS home screen.

action: I say '请放音乐，哆嗦，张杰，心太细。'
action_brief: I say '请放音乐，哆嗦，张杰，心太细。'
environment: Phone opens the Taobao application splash screen. Elevator indicator displays floor 9.
speech: 请放音乐，哆嗦，张杰，心太细。
details: I speak a voice command while tapping the shopping app icon on the home screen.

action: I dismiss a ¥120 coupon pop-up dialog in the Taobao app.
action_brief: I dismiss a ¥120 coupon pop-up.
environment: Taobao app loads its homepage and displays a red-and-orange promotional coupon pop-up stating '120元' with a '去使用' button, which closes.
details: I tap near the dismiss area of the pop-up modal to access the main shopping feed.

action: I scroll through the Taobao recommendation feed showing smart glasses and tech accessories.
action_brief: I scroll through the Taobao recommendation feed.
environment: Taobao app recommendation feed scrolls through product cards. Elevator reaches floor 15, illuminated on the floor indicator.
details: I use my right thumb to scroll down the product listing on the screen.

action: I lower the phone and look out into the hallway as the elevator doors open.
action_brief: I look at the hallway outside the elevator.
environment: Elevator sliding doors open to reveal a residential corridor with beige tiled floor, a white 3-drawer shoe cabinet against a brick-tiled wall, and apartment door marked '15B'.
details: My gaze shifts from the phone screen forward toward the white shoe cabinet next to door 15B.

action: I push open the apartment door marked '15B' while holding my phone in my hand.
action_brief: I open the door.
environment: Hallway outside apartment 15B with tiled floor and grey/wood door panel. Inside shows a lit residential interior with a dining table, open kitchen in the background, light-colored flooring, white walls, and a window area with a drying rack on the right.
details: My right arm pushes against the door panel next to the metallic handle while holding a smartphone displaying an app grid in my other hand.

action: I look at the wooden dining table covered with boxes, plastic bags, and an orange card.
action_brief: I look at the dining table.
environment: The door opens fully into the apartment. The dining table holds an open flat cardboard box, plastic shopping bags, a white bottle, glasses, and an orange tag labeled '50'.
details: Gaze rests on the center-left side of the dining table examining the items on top.

action: I look toward the window and clothes drying rack while saying '嗯。'
action_brief: I say '嗯。'
environment: View shifts toward the bright window with a window air conditioner, clothes hanging on a drying rack, a wire laundry bin, a floor sweeper/mop, and a white three-drawer dresser with shoes on the floor.
details: I look past the mop towards the bright natural light coming from the window.
